episodes.title: Listen Grip
episodes.blurb: A shape around starting a conversation.
episodes.material: an LED meter on a grip

caption.default: A voice button that dances when you talk.
caption.change: Press the grip and it listens through your mic, nothing else. The dots unroll into a sound meter, and only your voice moves it. Press again and it asks: go on, keep it, or close.
caption.reason: A thing you press, that answers only you when you need it. It can be put away and brought back.
caption.not: It doesn't write down what you say. That's a different build. This one is the press, and the listening. Next is how what you say becomes a command, and where it gets saved.
